verdict.rationale: The International Entrepreneur Rule is a fair question for an immigration-services product aimed at startups and founders, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only O-1, H-1B, L-1, TN, EB-1A/EB-1C and EB-2 NIW pathways. Nothing mentions entrepreneur parole or its qualifying-investment thresholds.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated
